targets.authors: Michalka SW, Kong L, Rosen ML, Shinn-Cunningham BG, Somers DC
targets.title: Short-term memory for space and time flexibly recruit complementary sensory-biased frontal lobe attention networks.
targets.evidence_quote: Our results reproduce, in a new paradigm, the finding by Michalka et al. (2015 ) of four bilateral sensory-biased structures anatomically interleaved along the precentral and inferior frontal sulci.
targets.outcome_quote: Our results are a robust replication of earlier findings from our laboratory ( Michalka et al., 2015 ), despite substantial differences in the cognitive tasks involved.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall robust-replication verdict for the sensory-biased regional organization.

reasoning: New fMRI measurements, a different paradigm and a sample partly overlapping the earlier sample retest a specific published finding. Seven participants participated in both studies, with new sessions over a year later; this is new-data replication. The specific target is Michalka et al. (2015), Experiment 1. Broader multiple-demand studies provide competing theoretical context; incidental consistency comparisons do not establish additional designed retests.
